integrity: Exact proof for all dimensions and all allowed characteristics. Four standalone standard-library scripts were executed successfully from the stated paths, including full inclusion-exclusion verification for the first nontrivial cubic-fourfold example. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The class counts the reduced union of designated sign-pairing planes only; it does not count all linear subspaces of the ambient Fermat cubic. Characteristic two is excluded by the signed-graph argument; characteristic three is excluded because the ambient cubic is not smooth. No individual cohomology decomposition or historical priority certification is asserted.
title: A uniform motivic generating series for coordinate-pairing planes on Fermat cubics
